description: Only clips that belong to a group are drawn. A hub point ("group") lists its members in "nn"; a member lists its hub. x,y: one exact t-SNE (perplexity 12, seed 42, PCA init, 1,000 iterations, Euclidean) of the kept clips alone, on the flattened 4,096-d latents. Groups were first screened on a joint t-SNE (Barnes-Hut, perplexity 30) of the 683 action-data clips and all 2,800 LARY clips. surface.height is a kernel density of the drawn points, a drawing aid only.
map_filter: A neighbour is drawn only if it lies within 4% of the map diagonal of its hub. Action-data groups need all four neighbours (within 6%); only LARY groups that join human hands and robots are used, the eight tightest, each with three of its five samples; transfer sources keep whichever of their four nearest clips pass. On the drawn map, members farther than 12% of its diagonal from their hub are dropped too, and a group needs three members. The transfer source "Grasp a bottle" has none of its four nearest clips among the 683 near it on the map, so it shows its four nearest clips among those drawn (all within 4% of the map diagonal).
neighbor_metric: Euclidean on the flattened (8,4,128) latent, no scaling or normalization

neighbor_rules.cross: Nearest clips whose dataset and task both differ from the hub (and from each other). No labels are used.
neighbor_rules.same: Nearest clips from the same dataset, each from a different task. No labels are used.
neighbor_rules.lary: LARY validation clips with the same official action class from other sources, selected in the LARY group package; ordered by latent distance.
neighbor_rules.source: Motion-transfer source and its nearest clips.
